text: The Lean 4 project 'sphere-eversions' (Massot et al.) aims to formalise:
choices: Smale's sphere eversion theorem (you can turn S² inside out without creasing)
explanation: The sphere eversion project (formalised in Lean 4 / Mathlib) gives a fully formal proof that S² can be continuously turned inside out. A landmark example of advanced topology in a proof assistant.
